tokenName: Pakistan International Airlines Commodity-Backed Warehouse Token
underlyingAsset: Pakistan state enterprise commodity receipt — mineral ore / agricultural produce stored at certified government warehousing facility
description: Pakistan International Airlines issues warehouse receipt tokens backed by commodities produced or procured by the enterprise. Token holders receive pro-rata claims on certified stored inventory, enabling smallholder suppliers to access immediate liquidity.
regulatoryFramework: State-Owned Enterprises (Governance and Operations) Act 2023; SECP Virtual Asset Rules

tokenName: Pakistan International Airlines Workforce Service Contract Token
underlyingAsset: Pakistan public sector service contract — vetted suppliers, maintenance contractors and consultants engaged by Pakistan International Airlines
description: Pakistan International Airlines tokenises service contracts with suppliers and independent contractors. Micro-enterprises and artisans can tokenise outstanding invoices as collateral for working-capital loans, eliminating the 90-day government payment delay.
regulatoryFramework: State-Owned Enterprises (Governance and Operations) Act 2023; SECP Virtual Asset Rules

tokenName: Pakistan International Airlines Infrastructure PPP Token
underlyingAsset: Public-private partnership project in Pakistan — managed by Pakistan International Airlines with mandatory 60% local employment quota
description: Pakistan International Airlines issues PPP tokens for capital infrastructure projects. Each token represents fractional participation in project revenue under a concession agreement. Smart contracts automatically enforce local hiring targets before milestone payments are released.
regulatoryFramework: State-Owned Enterprises (Governance and Operations) Act 2023; SECP Virtual Asset Rules

tokenName: Pakistan International Airlines Public Real Estate Asset Token
underlyingAsset: Government-owned land and property portfolio managed by Pakistan International Airlines in Pakistan
description: Pakistan International Airlines tokenises government property assets to unlock dormant balance-sheet value. Citizens can invest from 1 PKR unit and earn rental income proportional to token holdings, converting public assets into inclusive wealth-generation instruments.
regulatoryFramework: State-Owned Enterprises (Governance and Operations) Act 2023; SECP Virtual Asset Rules

tokenName: Pakistan International Airlines Verified Labour Proof-of-Work Token
underlyingAsset: Daily economic activity of casual workers, contract staff and micro-vendors contracted by Pakistan International Airlines
description: Pakistan International Airlines issues proof-of-work tokens for every verified day of labour performed by casual workers on government contracts. Accumulated tokens build a portable credit score accepted by partner lenders, replacing the collateral requirement for the unbanked workforce.
regulatoryFramework: State-Owned Enterprises (Governance and Operations) Act 2023; SECP Virtual Asset Rules

tokenName: Pakistan International Airlines Capital Project Milestone Token
underlyingAsset: Construction and development project milestones verified by independent engineers at Pakistan International Airlines projects in Pakistan
description: Pakistan International Airlines issues milestone tokens that unlock progress payments only when independent inspectors verify project completion at each gate. This eliminates corruption in public procurement and ensures employment-creating contractors are paid promptly and fairly.
regulatoryFramework: State-Owned Enterprises (Governance and Operations) Act 2023; SECP Virtual Asset Rules

tokenName: Pakistan International Airlines Agricultural Offtake Token
underlyingAsset: Smallholder and commercial farm produce procured by Pakistan International Airlines under government off-take programmes in Pakistan
description: Pakistan International Airlines tokenises forward purchase agreements with smallholder farmers who supply the enterprise. Farmers receive pre-season financing in token form, redeemable at harvest. This removes predatory middlemen and connects subsistence farmers to institutional buyers.
regulatoryFramework: State-Owned Enterprises (Governance and Operations) Act 2023; SECP Virtual Asset Rules

tokenName: Pakistan International Airlines SME Supply Chain Participation Token

description: Pakistan International Airlines tokenises the economic value of SME contracts under its preferential procurement programme. Tokens can be listed on the national digital exchange, enabling impact investors to co-fund local businesses while earning competitive returns.
regulatoryFramework: State-Owned Enterprises (Governance and Operations) Act 2023; SECP Virtual Asset Rules

description: Pakistan International Airlines launches a basket ETF token spanning all 15 tokenised asset classes within its operations. A single token gives retail investors diversified exposure to infrastructure, commodities, labor, SME supply chains and government bonds from 1 PKR unit.
regulatoryFramework: State-Owned Enterprises (Governance and Operations) Act 2023; SECP Virtual Asset Rules

description: Pakistan International Airlines issues fractional equity tokens representing an economic interest in enterprise profits. description: Pakistan International Airlines tokenises government-guaranteed development bonds accessible from 1 PKR unit. Proceeds finance electrification, water, transport or ICT expansion projects. Quarterly coupon payments are streamed directly to token holders' wallets in real time.
